info.title: Harp.Toolkit
info.description: A tool for inspecting, updating and interfacing with Harp devices from the command-line.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Tool for inspecting, updating and interfacing with Harp devices.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --port
options.description: Name of the serial port used to communicate with the device.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout in milliseconds to receive a response from the device. Use -1 to wait indefinitely. [default: 2000]

commands.name: list
commands.description: List all available system serial ports.

commands.name: update
commands.description: Update the device firmware from a local HEX file.

options.name: --port
options.description: Name of the serial port used to communicate with the device.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Timeout in milliseconds to receive a response from the device. Use -1 to wait indefinitely. [default: 2000]

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the firmware file.

options.name: --force
options.description: Force a firmware update, skipping the compatibility check when the device cannot answer. [default: False]

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate firmware or interface code for Harp devices.

commands.name: interface
commands.description: Generate device interface code for a target language.

commands.name: csharp
commands.description: Generate reactive programming API and async API.

options.name: -ns
options.description: The namespace for the generated code. The default is `Harp.DeviceName`.

options.name: -o
options.description: Location to place the generated output. [default: .]

arguments.name: METADATA
arguments.description: The path to the file describing the device registers. [default: device.yml]

commands.name: python
commands.description: Generate the Harp Python device interface.

options.name: -o
options.description: Location to place the generated output. [default: .]

arguments.name: METADATA
arguments.description: The path to the file describing the device registers. [default: device.yml]

commands.name: firmware
commands.description: Generate firmware headers and implementation template.

options.name: --ios
options.description: The path to the file describing the device IO pins. [default: ios.yml]

options.name: --implementation
options.description: Generate implementation (.c) files. The default is false. [default: False]

options.name: -o
options.description: Location to place the generated output. [default: .]

arguments.name: METADATA
arguments.description: The path to the file describing the device registers. [default: device.yml]

commands.name: metadata
commands.description: Generate device register metadata file from legacy XLS files.

options.name: -o
options.description: Location to place the generated output. [default: .]

arguments.name: REGISTERS.XLS
arguments.description: The path to the file describing the device registers.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify device conformance against the Harp specification.

options.name: --port
options.description: Name of the serial port used to communicate with the device.

options.name: --report
options.description: Path to the HTML report generated after running tests.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed results for each test. [default: False]

options.name: --prerelease
options.description: Include checks against specification text outside the stable baseline. [default: False]

options.name: --clock-port
options.description: Serial port of the reference clock device. Enables clock alignment tests.

options.name: --pps-event
options.description: Address of the register on the tested device (--port) that reports the incoming PPS pulse from the reference clock device. Enables the PPS alignment test, which also requires --clock-port.

options.name: --clock-samples
options.description: Number of PPS event pairs to collect for the PPS alignment test. [default: 5]

options.name: --metadata
options.description: The path to the file describing the device registers. Enables validation of the generated interface against a live read of every declared register, and cross-checks the WhoAmI, firmware and hardware versions.
